newsitem.title: USA: Interneuron to buy call options.
newsitem.headline: Interneuron to buy call options.

text.p: Interneuron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday it had arranged to buy up to 1.2 million call options on its own common stock.
The company said in a statement it also would issue call options on up to two million shares of its stock at a strike price of $40 a share.

The statement said it had made a call option arrangement with an unnamed financial institution "under which Interneuron intends to purchase in private transactions capped call options on its own common stock.
"These call options will give Interneuron the right to purchase from the financial institution shares of Interneuron common stock at specified strike prices to be determined."
The call options are expected to be exercisable only at their maturities. They will be specified dates from about four to 16 months following the dates the call options are purchased by Interneuron.

"In exchange for the purchase of these call options, Interneuron intends to sell to the same financial institution call options entitling the institution to purchase from Interneuron at a strike price expected to be $40 per share, up to approximately 2,000,000 shares of Interneuron common stock in May 1999."

Glenn L. Cooper, president and chief executive of Interneuron, said, "The call options purchased by Interneuron will provide Interneuron the right to acquire its common stock at fixed prices and will thus allow the company to benefit from potential appreciation in its stock price above the strike prices."
